name: html-custom-block-low-confidence-unchanged
description: A custom-element subtree with weak structural signals does NOT clear the conservative custom_block gate, so no block type is generated (issue #497). A custom element holding only text keeps that text as an editable core/paragraph instead of an unsupported_element fallback: its runtime formatting is not portable, its text is.

source_reference.notes: Negative control for generation: a single inline child carries no custom_block signal. Its text converts to a paragraph.

legacy_comparison.reason: Negative control for new producer-link behavior; no downstream legacy comparison.
